baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb rooted in ه ل ك predicates ruin of the possessed noun سلطانيه, while عني marks separation from its possessor.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ruin and extinction act on authority and rule themselves. The line presents an operative governing capacity that has collapsed and detached, not merely a title that failed on one occasion.

activation_trace.role: Ruin, loss, and extinction give the disappearance of power a terminal character.
Authority and rule identify the lost thing as the speaker's governing capacity.

changed_reading.before: My authority is gone from me.
changed_reading.after: The governing power I possessed has itself collapsed and separated from me.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سلطان can name a compelling proof, and هلك can render its loss as a fall into futility.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker loses the warrant by which he could prevail in a dispute. What was expected to overpower an opponent can no longer establish a case.

activation_trace.role: The overpowering-proof image supplies a warrant capable of winning a case.
The valley-of-futility image turns the warrant's loss into exposure as ineffective.

changed_reading.after: The proof by which I expected to prevail has collapsed into futility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sharp-tongue branch of س ل ط remains attached to سلطانيه, while هلك supplies expenditure to exhaustion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line distinguishes having a voice from having a voice that acts on others. The speaker can utter the lament, but his once forceful, commanding speech has spent its efficacy.

activation_trace.role: The forceful sharp tongue supplies verbal power rather than political office.
Exhausted effort makes the tongue's force spent even though speech continues.

changed_reading.after: My sharp commanding tongue is spent: I can speak, but my speech no longer carries force.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed record entails judgment, and the account is calculated even though the speaker says he did not know it. سلطان as proof is gone because an external record has already closed the evidentiary field.

activation_trace.role: The compelling-proof image supplies the defense the speaker no longer possesses.
Extinction makes the defense conclusively unavailable rather than merely weak.
Writing that fixes and entails a judgment supplies the binding record.
Knowledge contrasts the speaker's claimed failure to know with the record's disclosure.
Counting and accounting supply the completed calculation against which he must answer.

structural_cues: Receipt of the left-hand book is followed by disavowal of knowledge of the account and then by the losses of wealth and سلطان.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding writing, calculation, ignorance, and compelling proof; I infer a forensic process in which the external record displaces self-authored defense. سلطان as governing power remains viable.

changed_reading.before: My proof has disappeared without a stated mechanism.
changed_reading.after: Once the fixed record computes my account, no personal warrant can reopen the case.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two book-receipt scenes oppose the right-hand image of power and right to the left-hand image of abasement or ill outcome. The speaker's سلطان perishes as his record places him on the side without favorable standing.

activation_trace.role: Authority and delegated standing supply the status lost by the speaker.
Ruin makes the adverse change of standing irreversible.
A writing that fixes judgment makes handed placement consequential rather than decorative.
The right hand as power and right supplies the favorable standing shown in the first case.
The left as a locus of abasement or ill outcome supplies the condemned speaker's adverse standing.

structural_cues: The parallel introductions in verses 19 and 25 differ at right versus left, and only the left-hand recipient proceeds to the confession that his سلطان has perished.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed judgment, right-hand power or right, left-hand abasement, and lost authority; I infer a reversal of standing. The handed branches may function symbolically without defining سلطان itself.

changed_reading.before: My authority disappears independently of how I receive the book.
changed_reading.after: The left-hand judgment strips me of favorable standing, so the authority or right I claimed no longer exists.

context_deltas.mechanism: The account root activates both calculation and sufficiency, while the next confession denies wealth any sufficiency. The fixed account is enough against the speaker precisely where his assets and personal warrant are not enough for him.

activation_trace.role: Compelling proof supplies the personal counter-case that fails to suffice.
Futility marks the personal counter-case as unusable.
The fixed writing supplies the record whose contents can be sufficient for judgment.
Sufficiency activates an account that is enough to settle the case against him.
Failed sufficiency gives the inverse: wealth is not enough to protect him.

structural_cues: The sequence names the account, then failed sufficiency of wealth, then the death of سلطان in three consecutive verses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies account, sufficiency in two roots, fixed writing, and futile proof; I infer the directional contrast that the record is enough against him while his resources are not enough for him. حساب can remain strictly calculation without the sufficiency activation.

changed_reading.before: My wealth and proof separately fail me.
changed_reading.after: The account alone is sufficient to settle my case, while neither wealth nor my own warrant is sufficient to save me.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent clauses distinguish two failures. Material wealth loses its capacity to suffice, then social or political capital itself perishes. Together they enact a staged bankruptcy of resources that had been convertible into protection.

activation_trace.role: Authority and rule supply the speaker's institutional capital.
Ruin makes institutional capital cease rather than merely fail to pay out.
Sufficiency names the expected protective function that wealth fails to perform.
Accumulated wealth supplies the first stock of worldly resources in the paired confession.

structural_cues: Verses 28 and 29 are adjacent first-person clauses with the same عني relation and matching possessive pause endings, but different predicates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sufficiency of wealth followed by perished authority; I classify them as material and institutional capital and infer that both had served as protection. سلطان as proof would make the pair money and argument instead.

changed_reading.before: Money failed, and then an unrelated office was lost.
changed_reading.after: Both stores of protective capital are bankrupt: wealth cannot help, and the power that might deploy it no longer exists.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coercive force once associated with the speaker is followed immediately by his capture, shackling, and insertion into a connected chain. سلطان has not only vanished; its direction reverses, turning the former agent of control into controlled material.

activation_trace.role: Coercive force let loose supplies the kind of agency the speaker has lost.
Extinction removes the speaker's capacity to direct coercion.
Capture and imprisonment reverse the speaker from holder of power to seized object.
A collar binding a limb gives the reversal a bodily mechanism.
Connected links turn coercion into an external system surrounding the captive.
Insertion of one thing into another makes the former controller into material routed through the system.

structural_cues: The first-person lament ends at verse 29; verses 30-32 immediately make the speaker the object of a sequence of plural imperatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercive power, capture, binding, linked chain, and insertion; I infer a reversal in the direction of agency. The sequence can also be read simply as punishment after an unrelated loss of office.

changed_reading.before: My ability to coerce others has disappeared.
changed_reading.after: The direction of coercion has reversed: the former controller is seized, bound, and routed as an object.

context_deltas.mechanism: The broken-need branch of هلك opens a social reversal. One who did not mobilize support for the person marked by lowly need loses authority and is left without even an intimate supporter.

activation_trace.role: Broken need and dependence recast the result of lost authority as destitution.
Authority and rule supply the high social position from which the reversal begins.
Urging action supplies the social mobilization the speaker refused to perform.
Feeding another identifies the concrete support withheld from the needy.
The abasement of poverty supplies the low social condition mirrored back onto him.
Close kinship or intimacy supplies the support network now absent.

structural_cues: The capture sequence is explained by his failure to urge feeding the poor, then followed by the statement that he has no intimate supporter there.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authority, broken dependence, withheld support, poverty, and absent intimacy; I infer a moral-social role reversal. The live alternative is that these are cause and penalty without mirrored social form.

changed_reading.before: A former ruler has merely lost rank.
changed_reading.after: One who would not activate support for the powerless is reduced from authority to unsupported dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned speaker can still produce a lament, but his speech cannot execute anything. Immediately after his confession, executable imperatives belong to another voice and make him the object of capture.

activation_trace.role: The forceful sharp tongue supplies the lost capacity for speech to act on others.
Exhausted effort leaves utterance audible but functionally spent.
Spoken utterance supplies the condemned person's continuing but ineffective lament.
Capture gives the succeeding command an effect on the former speaker's body.

structural_cues: The first-person قول and lament occupy verses 25-29; at verse 30 the speaker falls silent and becomes the object of commands to seize and bind him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies utterance, exhausted force, and capture; the imperative transition supplies the arrow that efficacy has moved to another voice. The ordinary authority or proof senses of سلطان remain stronger lexical readings.

changed_reading.before: My commanding tongue has simply become tired.
changed_reading.after: I can still lament, but my words execute nothing; the only effective commands now act upon me.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the capacity-and-range branch of ذ ر ع inside a literal chain measurement and maps that range onto سلطان. It remains anchored in the focus coercive-force branch and the immediate binding sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a sequence-based spatial analogy, not as the lexical meaning of ذراع here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speaker's coercive reach perishes immediately before the captor's chain receives an explicit reach and connected extension.

activation_trace.role: Coercive force supplies the lost personal reach.
Extinction reduces that personal reach to nothing.
Capacity and extent turn the chain's stated measure into the captor's replacement reach.
Connected links give the replacement reach a continuous material form.

changed_reading.before: My power ended, and a long chain appears independently.
changed_reading.after: As my personal reach collapses, punishment's reach is extended, connected, and explicitly measured around me.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the dialectal lighting-oil branch of س ل ط under سلطان. The immediate move to blazing fire keeps the material reversal visible and the focus root supplies loss; downstream prose must label it a lexical-image echo, never a direct translation of سلطانيه.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The lighting-oil branch remains rooted in the focus noun, whose resource is said to perish before the speaker is consigned to fire.

activation_trace.role: Oil used for lighting supplies a private, controllable source of illumination.
Ruin and loss extinguish the speaker's controllable lighting resource.
Blazing fire reverses controlled illumination into consuming heat controlled by another.

changed_reading.before: The speaker loses an abstract political resource before entering the fire.
changed_reading.after: His own controllable light-source is gone, and the only fire left is the consuming fire imposed on him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because the family-ruin image of ه ل ك normally belongs to a fuller idiom absent from the focus. It remains anchored through possessed authority and the context's explicit absence of an intimate; downstream prose should carry it only as a social-network analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The possessed سلطان can be socially embodied in household backing, while هلك permits that supporting body to be ruined.

activation_trace.role: Ruin in or of one's family supplies collapse of the authority-holder's social body.
Authority and rule supply the power formerly embodied by that household network.
Negation of the present condition makes the loss of support explicit.
Near kin and intimacy identify the personal support now absent.

changed_reading.before: An isolated individual loses an abstract office.
changed_reading.after: The household network that embodied my authority has collapsed, leaving me without even an intimate supporter.

strongest_changes: The fixed, computed record turns سلطان into a failed evidentiary warrant.
The immediate capture-and-chain sequence reverses سلطان from coercion exercised to coercion suffered.
The paired wealth and authority clauses stage bankruptcy of material and institutional protection.
The failure to support the needy returns as the authority-holder's own unsupported dependence.
summary.what_was_special: The local sequence supports unusually clean reversals: the account suffices where wealth does not, the controller becomes controlled, executable speech changes sides, and the person who withheld support is left unsupported.
remaining_uncertainties: Authority, compelling proof, and forceful speech remain coexisting senses of سلطان; the packet does not force one to absorb the others.
The handed-standing and moral-social inversions require reader-supplied directional arrows even though their elements are locally visible.
The measured-reach, lighting-oil, and household-support outliers are branch-distant and should never be rendered as direct lexical glosses.
